notes:
Inbound SMB lead via signup form; small support startup building an in-app assistant. Heavy focus on privacy & retention. Rep: Priya. SE loop for technical Qs.
- Source: self-serve signup + trial credit redeemed (2026-02-03)
- Concern: customer prompts may contain PII; need explicit opt-out per end-user and an easy delete flow.
- Asked: Do you store prompts? For how long? Can we opt-out per request? Can logs be disabled on hosted plan?
- Also asked about: SSO, audit logs, and contractual retention limits (30/90/180 days).
- Quote from CTO: "We need assurance prompts aren’t retained longer than 30 days by default and a way to turn off retention for specific customers."
- Notes from SE call (2026-02-11): Maya explained hosted defaults: ephemeral logs retained for 30 days for abuse/debug, opt-out options on paid tier to disable retention, and API flag for "do_not_log" available but requires policy + billing tier. SE to confirm exact SLA for deletion and whether embeddings stored by default.
- Action items: SE to confirm deletion SLA and provide sample policy language for customer TOS; AE to send privacy & retention one-pager + hosted security FAQ link.
- Customer classification: privacy-sensitive but price-conscious; likely to stay on hosted API if retention controls and an opt-out mechanism are documented and available via dashboard or API.
- They want a short doc we can share with their legal: one pager that states: default retention window, opt-out mechanics, deletion request process, contact for escalation, and reference to SOC2.
- POC ask: 2-week trial with do_not_log enabled for subset of traffic (they will validate no logging on a sandbox tenant).
- Timeline: aiming to decide by end of Feb if answers satisfactory; otherwise push to pilot in March.

use_case_summary: Primary: in-app support assistant that surfaces account info and triages tickets. Traffic bursty (morning support peak), latency tolerance ~200-500ms, cost sensitive. Embeddings for doc-match secondary but they want to avoid storing raw prompts in embeddings store if PII present. Looking to use hosted API for speed-to-market; will evaluate Dedicated later if retention controls are insufficient.
privacy_requirements_summary:
- Default retention must be documented (customer assumes 30d).
- Require API flag or header to opt-out of logging per request (do_not_log).
- Need deletion request process for prompts tied to user accounts.
- Prefer minimal access logs; retain only metrics for billing/usage aggregated.
- Contractual addendum requested referencing SOC2, audit logs, and specific retention cap (30d).
decision_criteria: 1) Clear documented retention defaults + deletion SLA; 2) Simple opt-out mechanism (API flag + dashboard toggle); 3) Pricing unaffected for basic hosted plan or low-cost add-on; 4) Legal sign-off on an addendum
sales_play_notes: SMB inbound - privacy-first. High chance to convert if we deliver a simple Do-Not-Log workflow and short legal one-pager. Offer 2-week POC with do_not_log enabled and support from SE. Emphasize hosted no-logs add-on and SOC2 compliance. Keep messages short and concrete.
final_comments: Avoid heavy enterprise language in initial comms; they want plain answers they can hand to legal. Priority: confirm whether embeddings service stores prompts by default and whether we can purge embeddings on request.
